title_cn: DIKWP 宇宙意识统一语义空间
title_en: DIKWP Unified Semantic Space for Universal Consciousness

normalization_thesis.cn: 所有宗教、文明、科学与哲学概念必须被投影到同一 DIKWP 坐标空间。归一是坐标统一，而非历史同一化；差异、歧义和新增概念均表示为空间内的向量、关系、语境或版本化扩展，不设置永久的空间外不可互译区。
normalization_thesis.en: Every religious, civilizational, scientific and philosophical concept is projected into one DIKWP coordinate space. Normalization unifies coordinates rather than asserting historical identity. Difference, ambiguity and novelty are represented as in-space vectors, relations, contexts or versioned extensions; no permanent extra-semantic untranslatable zone is permitted.

D.question: 发生了什么，何人何时以何种身体、仪器或传统记录条件接触到它？

I.question: 哪些差异、关系、边界、模式与语境使记录具有结构？

K.question: 如何形成概念、自我—世界模型、生成解释、规律主张与实践知识？

W.question: 何者值得追求、避免或承担，后果、权衡与正当性如何？

P.question: 主体、共同体或宇宙叙事朝向什么目的，如何行动并接受现实返回？

A sensed, measured or instrumentally registered datum.
An observation, testimony or disciplined first-person report with source conditions.
Embodied, ecological, energetic or material constraints without presuming a metaphysical reduction.
Temporal succession, ancestry, transmission or append-only worldline record.
A distinction that makes information possible.
Relations, dependence, participation, covenant, kinship or co-arising.
Regularity, proportion, rhythm, symbol or structured correlation.
Self/other, sacred/profane, lawful/unlawful, organism/environment or role boundary.

A declared transformation between semantic systems with explicit confidence and loss.
A concept, category, doctrinal distinction or explanatory primitive.
A causal, constitutive, generative or dependent-production account.
A model of reality, nature, history, society, transcendence or possible worlds.
A model of self, person, soul, no-self, relational identity or center of agency.
A law, truth, order, revelation claim, theorem, working proposition or invariant.
Ritual, meditation, prayer, cultivation, experiment, craft or pedagogy.

operators.cn: 把原生概念及语境投影为 DIKWP 概率向量。
将所有非负权重归一，总和为1。
在同一坐标中计算相似、方向差异与目的距离。
未覆盖概念必须归入 D/I/K/W/P 的版本化子节点，并声明父坐标、证据与修订条件。
把传统或文明的多个概念归一为可比较的 DIKWP 重心。
目的驱动行动后，现实结果返回 D 并修订 I/K/W/P。

semantic_closure_rules: No term is classified as permanently outside DIKWP space.
A source term may map to multiple coordinates and multiple context-conditioned vectors.
Normalization never by itself proves doctrinal equivalence, scientific truth or historical identity.
Every mapping retains source, school, context, confidence, version and loss notes as in-space metadata.
New distinctions extend the ontology under D, I, K, W or P; they do not create a sixth metaphysical remainder class.
Cosine similarity is a comparison tool, not a theological or scientific verdict.
